messages:
incident-bot: PAGING oncall: high-severity alert - multiple GPU decode/stream nodes reporting CUDA OOMs and container restarts across cluster 'us-west-2-decode'. Error spike started ~3300123400, increased error rate -> request drops. Auto-scaler triggered churn. Paging to @alice_oncall and @bob_sre :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: I'm on it. any customer-facing impact yet?

bob_sre: Seeing 502/503s and streaming truncations, ~18% error rate for decode streaming route /v1/stream/decode. Node logs show repeated Cuda out-of-memory in decode loop: `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` and container restart reason: OOMKilled.

carol_platform: Metrics show a sudden KV-cache growth for model 'redwood-xxl-v2' with long prefix reuse + a few very large max_tokens headers from a subset of tenants -> token-storm pattern.

dave_reliability: Is this the same token-spiral we saw last quarter? Could be misconfigured SDK clients sending erroneously huge max_tokens or header bypass.

eve_support: We have a support ticket from acme-corp reporting dropped streams and partial responses, ticket #INC-4123. They reported spikes starting ~10m ago.

frank_prod: Prior mitigation earlier was to throttle on prefix size and enforce per-request max_tokens at the gateway. Is that still enabled?

bob_sre: Gateway config shows per-route max_tokens enforcement is OFF for /v1/stream/decode due to a recent rollout (config PR 2456). That explains the misconfig surface.

alice_oncall: Immediate plan: 1) re-enable per-route max_tokens enforcement at the edge (hotpatch) 2) temporarily disable streaming for the affected model variant 3) put affected nodes into evacuation pool (no new allocations) 4) failover routing to cpu-small fallback for critical customers. Who can flip the gateway?

carol_platform: I can roll the hotpatch. Preparing a safe command: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/configs/hotpatch -d '{"route":"/v1/stream/decode","enforce_max_tokens":true,"max_tokens":1024}'` -> will apply globally in ~20s with immediate effect on new requests.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by carol_platform: hotpatch/configs  => apply started at 3300123500, status: in_progress.

monitoring-bot: Alert update: decode error rate peaked at 22% at 3300123485; currently 20%. GPU memory pressure metric for decode pool shows 95th percentile jetting from 65% -> 98% in the last 5m.

bob_sre: I'm going to cordon three nodes showing repeated OOM cycles: decode-node-7, decode-node-9, decode-node-12. Running `kubectl drain` with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to evacuate.

alice_oncall: Also start a temporary rate-limit rule for bursty tenants: set per-tenant streaming RPS cap to 2 for 10m. Carol, can you add?

carol_platform: Adding rate-limit rule now. CLI: `rictl rate-limit create --scope tenant --match tenant_id in (acme-corp, sandbox-* ) --limit 2 --duration 600` -> applied at 3300123522.

frank_prod: For customer comms: we should send a short note to impacted customers (acme-corp + demo orgs) mentioning degraded streaming and that we're throttling bursts while we stabilize. @eve_support can you draft?

eve_support: Drafting: "We're experiencing streaming interruptions for a subset of customers caused by excessive streaming token requests. We've applied protections and are working on full recovery. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." Will send after confirmation.

deploy-bot: hotpatch/configs finished at 3300123550 -> success. New requests to /v1/stream/decode now have max_tokens enforced.

monitoring-bot: Post-hotpatch: decode error rate dropped to 9% at 3300123580. GPU mem pressure falling to 78%.

bob_sre: Eviction/drain succeeded on the three nodes. Restart was causing thrash; drained pods moved to healthy nodes. Scheduling increases on pool to absorb load while we revert bad clients.

alice_oncall: Next step: disable streaming for model variant 'redwood-xxl-v2-8bit' to stop long-tail token-storms. Carol, can you toggle model routing to fallback variant 'redwood-xxl-v2-4bit' (lower performance but smaller memory footprint) for public traffic?

carol_platform: Flipping routing policy: `rictl routing update --model redwood-xxl-v2-8bit --fallback redwood-xxl-v2-4bit --scope public` -> applied 3300123655.

monitoring-bot: After fallback: error rate steady at ~3%, GPU mem pressure 60%. No new OOMs in last 2m.

alice_oncall: Customer impact summary for post mortem: ~12 minutes of elevated error rates (peak 22%). Affected: acme-corp, sandbox orgs. Immediate customer-visible effect: streaming truncations and dropped responses; non-streaming synchronous API mostly unaffected. Root cause hypothesis: configuration rollback disabled route-level max_tokens enforcement, combined with a small set of clients sending unusually large token requests and a KV-cache growth pattern leading to steady OOMs.

frank_prod: Action items: (A) re-enable test that asserts per-route max_tokens can't be disabled in prod (owner: infra-tests) (B) add anomaly detection for sudden kv-cache growth per model (owner: eng-runtime) (C) customer rate-limiter defaults to conservative caps and needs visibility (owner: product)

alice_oncall: Handoff to oncoming shift: @bob_sre will continue monitoring until full recovery and follow-up. I'm going to update the incident page and send the external note.

bob_sre: Acknowledged. I'll keep track of node stability and watch for recurrences. Will also correlate logs for tenant header misuse.

eve_support: Sent initial notice to impacted customers at 3300123700. I'll collect any escalations and feed into the incident doc.

alice_oncall: Thank you all. Incident -> mitigated. Follow-ups and RCA to be scheduled. Closing rotation handoff at 3300123820. :white_check_mark:
